hero.title: Bring your card sorter into Discord
hero.description: Magic Vault's Discord bot posts a message for every card as it's sorted, alerts your server when something goes wrong, and answers /stats on demand, so you don't have to keep the monitor page open to know what's happening.
hero.selfHostedNote: The bot runs as its own process (packages/bot) alongside the rest of Magic Vault. See the README for the env vars it needs if you're self-hosting.

setup.title: Link a server in under a minute
setup.description: Connecting Discord doesn't touch your hardware or scanning setup. It's a few steps in the app and in Discord.

steps.title: Add the bot
steps.description: Add the Magic Vault bot to your Discord server. Requires the Manage Server permission.

steps.title: Generate a code
steps.description: In Magic Vault, open Settings > Notifications and generate a link code. It's only valid for a few minutes.

steps.title: Run /link
steps.description: In your Discord server, run /link <code> with the code from Notifications. Requires the Manage Server permission.

steps.title: Pick your channels
steps.description: Back on the Notifications page, choose where scans and alerts get posted, per collection if you like, and add rules for which cards go where.

commands.title: Commands
commands.description: The bot only needs two commands. Everything else is set up in the app.

link.description: Link this Discord server to a Magic Vault organization.

stats.description: Show this organization's collection stats, optionally limited to one collection.

features.title: What gets posted
features.description: Once a server is linked, the bot keeps it updated automatically. No polling, no refreshing a dashboard.

items.title: Card-scan notifications
items.description: Every card sorted posts an embed with its name, price (and foil price), collection, game, the captured scan photo, and a link straight to the live monitor.

items.title: Error & status alerts
items.description: Sorter jams, feeder issues, and other errors post separately so they don't get lost in the scan feed.

items.title: On-demand stats
items.description: /stats replies with card count and estimated value for the whole org or a single collection, right in Discord.

items.title: Live presence
items.description: The bot's status cycles through the games your Magic Vault instance supports, so it's obviously online and connected.
